description: Figure 3 presents a line chart illustrating the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate, as part of an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis represents the model variants, labeled as “Full model (MS-FSLHate)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”, arranged sequentially from left to right. The y-axis represents the performance metrics—precision, recall, and F1-score—in percentages, with values ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. Three distinct lines are plotted: the precision metric is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 65.45% and ending at 65.44%; the recall metric is depicted as a dashed green line with triangular markers, beginning at 65.78% and concluding at 56.82%; and the F1-score metric is represented by a dash-dotted red line with square markers, starting at 65.56% and ending at 57.74%. Each line shows a gradual decline across the model variants, with the recall metric experiencing the most significant drop, falling from 65.78% to 56.82%.
